title: Peacock waits for the beat drop
storyboard: Film: creator lip-syncs the trending sound's build-up, hard cut on the drop to the peacock fanning
caption:
He's been practising this drop all season.

High-speed video showed that the eyespot feathers in the train are in resonance at the same frequency as the rattle.
